title: Email signature with Graphics
slide_intent: Decide how a graphic should accompany an email signature. The recipient must be able to find the sender and contact details before encountering a campaign message.
strategic_value: A common text block can connect everyday correspondence to an event or movement-wide milestone without changing the sender’s identity.
demonstration: Two signatures repeat the same name and contacts. One ends with an anniversary strip and the other with the athlete oath. Additional event and volunteer graphics line the lower edge.
practical_value: Keep the text hierarchy fixed and choose a relevant graphic to follow it. Check that its scale preserves the contact block as a readable unit.

content_islands.name: Signature rules
content_islands.spec: List the text settings and the purpose of the graphic at left. Number the parts so their counterparts can be found in the examples.

content_islands.name: Paired signatures
content_islands.spec: Use two side-by-side signatures with matching contact lines. Change the closing graphic while preserving the common structure above it.

content_islands.name: Graphic options
content_islands.spec: Run the alternative event, audience and volunteer examples along the bottom as separate assets.
